about.title: Our story
about.subtitle: A family fruit business, serving customers since 2021.

milestones.title: The beginning
milestones.text: Our family started PM Elite Fruits with a small stock of seasonal fruit.

milestones.title: First regular customers
milestones.text: Word spread by mouth, and our first regular customers began ordering every week.

milestones.title: Berries and bulk orders
milestones.text: We added berries and started taking orders from juice shops and events.

milestones.title: Online ordering
milestones.text: We launched online ordering, so you can order in English, Marathi or Hindi.

about.familyText: From sorting the fruit to ringing your doorbell, our family handles your order ourselves. You see the same faces every time, and you can call us directly if anything is wrong.
about.ownerText: Prashant Mohite runs PM Elite Fruits. For orders, bulk requests or any question, call him directly or message him on WhatsApp.
